text:
JWT `exp` in seconds. `Date.now()` in milliseconds.

**Bug:**
```js
if (Date.now() > payload.exp) // wrong — ms vs s
```

**Fix:**
```js
if (Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) > payload.exp) // convert to seconds
```

Or flip: `payload.exp * 1000 < Date.now()`.

Use library (`jsonwebtoken`) — handles this + signature verify + clock skew. Roll-your-own JWT check = pain.
